OAuth Client ID (only needed for admin allowlisting)
Using a custom connector

Note: creating custom connectors allows you to connect multiple Airtable accounts to your ChatGPT account.

1

Open Settings → Apps → Advanced Settings and enable Developer mode.

2

Select Create app.

3

Enter MCP Server URL: https://mcp.airtable.com/mcp.

4

Select Authentication: OAuth.

5

Open Advanced OAuth Settings → Client Registration.

For automatic OAuth client creation
Select Registration Method: Dynamic Client Registration.
After completing the OAuth flow, you will find your OAuth client in your Airtable Builder Hub.
For manual OAuth client creation
Select Registration Method: User-Defined OAuth Client.
Follow the Airtable MCP manual OAuth client registration steps to create an OAuth client with the ChatGPT-supplied Callback URL.
Enter its OAuth Client ID (and optionally OAuth Client Secret) in the ChatGPT console.
Select Token endpoint auth method: client_secret_basic.
6

Select Create and authorize via OAuth.
